fields.label: Deprecation Note
fields.options:
This configuration has moved.
Employee-pool rules — matches with an active employee, Do Not Rehire, and the minimum gap after exit — are now configured on TA Duplicity Check Settings, under “Duplicity Check with Employee Pool”, and are applied at the Job Offer.
Nothing on this form is read any more. It is kept so existing records stay readable; the detection that powers the Job Applicant’s Employee Record tab still runs, driven by the duplicity check fields.
